Man-Up order picker (HLO) - Den Hoorn -  €15.00 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) order picker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? The work is performed using a high-level combi truck. The operator sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is spacious enough for the worker to sit and move safely. The machine can reach heights of up to 12-16 meters, and the operator rises together with the cabin. Before ascending, the operator places an empty pallet on the forks. Occasionally, a full pallet is placed on the forks if it needs to be stored in the rack. When you are high in the air, you pick boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse.
